name: CyberSentinel DLP
description: Granular web activity control for managed endpoints: inspects and enforces uploads, downloads, attachments, sends and AI prompts across webmail, cloud storage, collaboration and generative-AI apps. Managed by CyberSentinel DLP.
_comment_content_scripts: Deliberately EMPTY. Everything is registered at runtime by the service
worker against the hosts in the app catalog (see registerGuardScripts in
A static <all_urls> entry would run the bridge on every page anyone opens,
which on MV3 means waking the service worker on every navigation — a real
cost paid overwhelmingly on pages where the extension has nothing to do.
It would also freeze the host list into the manifest, and the whole point
of the catalog being a server-side table is that adding a GenAI vendor
takes effect on the next sync rather than on the next extension release.
